title: Pass 3 reference table: reduced Koiter-type shell cord/varix spine coupling and mantle-edge thickness gradient / ontogenetic allometry for 2015-moulton-mollusc-aperture-spine-buckling.py
scope_note: Both Pass 2 remediation items are closed with reduced-order models, not with a full 3D finite-strain Koiter shell FEM (Rudraraju et al. 2019) nor with micro-CT thickness data. (1) The mantle-margin surface w(s,t) is relaxed under the linearised Koiter / Foppl-von Karman thin-shell energy on a Winkler foundation with a varix growth window and oblique spiral-cord ridge forcing; spines, their count, registration and tilt are emergent (noise initial condition). (2) The along-margin thickness gradient h(s) is INFERRED from the SHA-256-locked Murex pecten specimen spacing profile by the inverse WKB law h ∝ lambda^(4/3), fed into a graded-rigidity comb solver, and an allometric instar series h_1 ∝ L^beta is propagated analytically. Residuals carried to Pass 4: true finite-strain FE shell with growth tensor; measured micro-CT h(s) cross-sections of Chicoreus ramosus instars.

sources.use: hierarchical wavenumber law k^* = (3 K_s / (E h^3))^(1/4); local (WKB) extension to slowly varying h(s)
varix spines as mantle-margin buckling; spine positions relative to spiral cords in Muricidae (cord-templating hypothesis tested as a locking tongue)
mantle-edge growth stretch gamma and the elastic foundation picture of the margin
3D morphoelastic shell FEM framework that the reduced Koiter surface model approximates (residual)

sources.citation: Koiter WT (1966). On the nonlinear theory of thin elastic shells. Proc. Kon. Ned. Akad. Wetensch. B69:1-54.
sources.use: Koiter shell energy (membrane + bending) whose linearised, prestressed form is used here

sources.citation: Manor R, Hagberg A, Meron E (2008). Wave-number locking in spatially forced pattern-forming systems. EPL 83:10005.
sources.use: resonant spatial forcing and wavenumber-locking (Arnold-tongue) response of a pattern-forming system, the mechanism by which cord ridges lock varix spines

koiter_defaults.energy: U[w] = ∫∫ [ ½ D (∇²w)² − ½ P(t) (∂_s w)² + ½ K_0 w² + ¼ κ₃ w⁴ − f_cord(s,t) w ] ds dt,  D = 1, K_0 = (k_1^*)^4, P_c = 2 sqrt(D K_0), P(t) = P_c (1 + onset_excess) · window(t), κ₃ = 0.28 (k_1^*)² P_c, f_cord = eps_cord K_0 A_onset cos(k_c (s cos ψ + t sin ψ))
koiter_defaults.relaxation: semi-implicit spectral gradient flow (3000 steps, dt = 0.25 / (P k_1^{*2})) from band-limited noise, then L-BFGS-B polish on the same energy
koiter_defaults.spine_height_law: accreted height = 4.8 sqrt(gamma - gamma_c) mm (same elastica height law as solve_kirchhoff_elastica_spine_loop); wavelength frozen at onset
koiter_defaults.note_on_cord_representation: A pure foundation-stiffness modulation at the cord wavenumber k_c would parametrically pump k_c/2 (Mathieu resonance) and cannot register spines to cords; cords are therefore represented as additive ridge forcing (pre-deflection of the margin where cords meet it).

cord_locking_sweep.obliquity_quantisation: tan(psi) = (m_t / L_t) / (n_cords / L_s), integer m_t, so the cord field is bi-periodic on the (s,t) torus
cord_locking_sweep.rigid_spine_deregistration_estimate: tan(psi*) = lambda_c / (2 W) with lambda_c = 4.2 mm, 2W = 10 mm  =>  psi* = 22.8 deg; the emergent spines tilt toward the cords, so numerical de-registration occurs later (reported by the script)

thickness_gradient.method: inverse WKB: h(u)/h_bar = (lambda(u)/lambda_bar)^(4/3) from the specimen inter-spine spacing profile along the siphonal canal (u in [0,1]); periodic two-harmonic least-squares fit; floor 0.35
thickness_gradient.graded_comb: D(s) = (h(s)/h_bar)^3, uniform supercriticality P(s) = P_c(s) (1 + onset_excess), onset_excess = 0.04, 512 points, gradient flow 6000 steps + L-BFGS-B
thickness_gradient.status: INFERRED from specimen, not measured; micro-CT cross-sections of Chicoreus ramosus mantle edge across instars were NOT available offline (Pass 4 residual)

ontogeny.law: N_1(L) = L / lambda_1(h_1(L)) with h_1 = h_ref (L / L_ref)^beta  =>  N_1 ∝ L^(1 − 3 beta / 4)
ontogeny.status: analytic propagation of the wavelength law; the allometric exponent beta of real Chicoreus ramosus instars is unknown here (Pass 4 residual: measure h_1 across instars by micro-CT)
